checks: Bind the exact ticket, work identity, one retained source path, byte count, and SHA-256.
Reassemble complete source text and every original CR/LF line terminator from the TEI candidate after restoring every source-located underscore delimiter.
Retain every blank-delimited source block and each blank-line delimiter in source order.
Use only exact source-line heading locators, explicit parent relations, and attached title-line runs in the bound profile.
Reject ordinary prose as a heading even when it begins with a heading keyword; reject missing or altered mapped headings.
Independently derive heading selection, title attachment, line, block, member, and omission accounting from the exact source.
Verify that mapped title and following content lines remain descendants of their declared source heading.
Verify TEI sourceDesc/reference, source-correction attestation, nonacceptance, and rights disclaimer bindings.
Validate against the bound TEI P5 schema and candidate-package contract.
Keep the candidate nonaccepted; make no rights-clearance, human-acceptance, or publication claim.
Inventory every physical underscore and classify ASCII alphanumeric-internal underscores as literal source text before pairing Gutenberg emphasis delimiters.
Record every emphasis opener and closer with exact line, column, source byte offset, marker digest, complete raw source-slice digest, and visible fragment hashes.
Verify every emphasis interior is represented as hi rend=italic without the outer delimiters; multiline continuations reference the opening fragment.
Reconstruct the exact raw source from readable TEI and delimiter locators; verify the long 566-character emphasis span and all physical line endings.
Reject a source-underscore rendition or any TEI that retains an outer Gutenberg delimiter in readable italic content.
oracle_independence: The oracle owns the exact work and source identity constants and heading-map digest, uses its own CR/LF scanner, literal-underscore classifier, balanced delimiter state machine, source-byte offset calculation, and TEI traversal, and does not import either builder. It independently derives every emphasis span, exact delimiter locator and source-slice hash, literal marker inventory, and visible fragment; it verifies that the candidate omits only paired outer markers, emits hi rend=italic, and reconstructs the raw retained source byte-for-byte. The profile map must match the oracle-owned heading locators and exact retained source before it can pass.
rejected_mutations: empty or ambiguous source underscore pair
incorrect emphasis-delimiter accountability locator or digest
missing or extra italic emphasis fragment
source underscore marker deletion or alteration
source underscore span deletion or movement
source_inventory: one explicit primary-source member; no adjacent-source traversal

source_underscore_policy.classification_rule: An underscore between ASCII letters or digits is literal source text and is not a Project Gutenberg emphasis delimiter. Other underscore characters are emphasis delimiters and must form balanced, nonempty pairs within one source block.
source_underscore_policy.pairing_scope: classify ASCII alphanumeric-internal underscores as literal; pair remaining emphasis delimiters within each blank-line-delimited source block
source_underscore_policy.representation: Omit each paired outer delimiter from readable TEI; encode its exact interior as hi rend=italic, split only at retained source-line boundaries, and link continuation fragments to the opening fragment. Preserve internal literal underscores in the readable text.
